tracking: lane E30 slice 4 (decision in PR #925): the brief is API-only (lane rule 3); the schedules screen is for the design builder on #453

gaps.POST /v1/workflows/schedules: creates a workflow schedule that starts a template on a cron calendar as its creator (a relaxed overlap policy is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/workflows/schedules: lists workflow schedules (paginated) with their state, next fire time and settings
gaps.GET /v1/workflows/schedules/:scheduleId: shows one workflow schedule and its 50 most recent fire times with their outcomes
gaps.PATCH /v1/workflows/schedules/:scheduleI: edits a workflow schedule's calendar, change, overlap, catch-up or jitter (audited; a relaxed overlap policy is a step-up)
gaps.POST /v1/workflows/schedules/:scheduleId: pauses a workflow schedule with a note (audited)
resumes a paused workflow schedule from now, with a note (audited)
starts one instance per fire time in a past range, at most 100, under the overlap policy (audited)
gaps.POST /v1/workflows/schedules/run-due: runs the workflow schedule sweep now (the same code the scheduler job runs)
